proof_scope: For every pair of bounded relative-type obstacles and positive parameter, there is a unique relative full-mass solution of the two-obstacle exponential equation. It has bounded relative type, is below their rooftop and dominates any full-mass supersolution. Solutions increase with the parameter and differ from the rooftop by at most (D+n log(2 lambda))/lambda for lambda at least one, off the poles. Energy and measures converge. This proves the supplied auxiliary equation without assuming finite untruncated coefficient mass.
